roadmap.title: Chapter 1: the one missable first
roadmap.text: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before anything else — it is the only trophy that can be missed. Then play Gone Fishing and finish Chapter 1.

roadmap.title: Story Chapters 2–5
roadmap.text: Play the main missions in order through to the final mission. Every trophy in this stage unlocks automatically; none can be missed.

roadmap.title: Strangers & freaks
roadmap.text: Work through the stranger mission strands (question-mark markers): Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, finishing each one's final mission. Completing 8 full strands also earns Strangers & Freaks. Do the finales before the story ends, while the strangers are still available.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & exploration
roadmap.text: Sweep Leonida region by region: the remaining meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK It locations, unique-animal hunting for Bret, 100 vehicles, exploring the whole state, all garage properties, and 10 Scooter Bros registrations. Nothing here is missable — it can all be done in free roam.

roadmap.title: Activities
roadmap.text: Races, drone races, the shooting range, fishing with Cal, arcade games, bowling, stunts and Combat Focus. Try each activity type once, then chase the gold medals and win counts.

roadmap.title: Challenges & situational
roadmap.text: The 50 challenges, robberies, and the situational trophies (4-star escape with your partner, 3 shops back-to-back, the airport departure, the showroom smash). Do the situational ones deliberately — they need the right setup, not luck. Read the Criminal Profile warning before Actions Speak Louder.

roadmap.title: Cleanup & 100%
roadmap.text: Finish whatever the checklist still shows, then check the in-game stats for 100% completion. A Long Road (100%) pops first; the platinum, Vice Got a Price!, follows automatically once the other 54 are earned.

steps.text: Finish the story through its final mission — the trophy pops at the credits.

disagree.note: SOURCES DISAGREE — both versions shown, neither picked.
versions: PowerPyx: the final mission is Starting From Zero, in Chapter 4.
Insider Gaming and the mission list: the final mission is The End of the Road, in Chapter 5 (Chapter 4 ends at mission 84, Chapter 5 ends at mission 91).

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE possibly missable trophy. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation first — it vanishes after Chapter 1. Then meditate at the remaining spots: 18 spots in 10 locations, both characters counting twice per spot.

steps.text: DO THIS FIRST: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, go to Jason's house in the morning and talk to Lucia in the kitchen when she mentions meditating.
Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept to complete the balcony meditation — it vanishes permanently after Chapter 1.
Meditate at the remaining spots across Leonida (18 spots in 10 locations); meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts twice.
Track progress in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and use the counter on this page.
Whether the Chapter 1 spot is strictly required is unconfirmed — every source says do it anyway to be safe.
Make a manual save after the Chapter 1 meditation.

disagree.note: SOURCES DISAGREE — both numbers shown, neither picked.
versions: PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer: 18 meditation spots for the trophy.
KeenGamer and HappyGamer: only 15 of the 18 are needed for the 100% checklist — the trophy and the checklist may count different things.
